note: 0.6 (Osama, 7 November 2026). F-35C in Airborne infantry: a copy of the F-35A card with all its bay loadouts, except each bay's 1x GBU-56 LJDAM 2000lb becomes 1x GBU-55 LJDAM 1000lb at +50 (the F-35B's GBU-55 bay option; the F-35A has the GBU-55 pylon in its data already). Same model, cost 240 and availability 2 as the F-35A. EA-18G Growler in Airborne infantry (Osama: Airborne gets the naval planes; dev.27 had it in USMC as a guess): a copy of the F/A-18D Hornet card, same model and icon, availability 2. Centerline and fuselage choices as the F/A-18D. Inner pylons: only the 2x fuel tank option, renamed 2x ECM jammer pods with the ECM picture. ECM 20% (ability 46 in place of the F/A-18D's 10%, ability 31). Outer pylons: only 2x AGM-88 HARM (+80, as the F-16CJ's 2x HARM), on the same pylons as the F/A-18D's 2x Maverick. Base 195, so the default loadout (2x AIM-120 +35, jammer pods +20, HARM +80) totals 330. Guess: 330 read as the default card total. Not yet run in a game.
